hint.zh: 首次使用、更换网关、连接排查
hint.en: First launch, gateways and connection problems

title.en: Connect to an Agent for the first time

zh: 首次打开后观看或跳过开场动画，在“认识彼此”里选择助理头像、填写助理昵称和你的称呼。
点击“下一步 · 连接网关”。在电脑端远程访问设置中复制远程 URL，填写到手机的服务器地址。
填写电脑端设置的网关用户名和密码，点击“验证并连接”。成功后进入助理页。
en: Watch or skip the welcome clip. Choose an assistant avatar and name, then optionally enter your own name.
Tap “Next · Connect a gateway”. Copy the Remote URL from the desktop remote-access settings into the server address field.
Enter the gateway username and password configured on the computer, then tap “Verify and connect”. A successful connection opens the assistant home.

tip.zh: 昵称只改变手机上的显示，不会更改 Agent、Profile 或网关账号。
tip.en: Display names only affect this app. They do not rename the Agent, Profile or gateway account.

title.zh: 更换服务器或重新登录
title.en: Change servers or sign in again

zh: 进入“我的 → 设置 → 远程网关”。
修改服务器地址或用户名，重新输入密码。
点击“验证并更新连接”，等待成功提示。需要退出当前连接时，使用页面底部的“清除连接并退出”。
en: Open Me → Settings → Remote gateway.
Change the server address or username and re-enter the password.
Tap “Verify and update connection” and wait for confirmation. To sign out, use “Clear connection and sign out” at the bottom.

tip.zh: 清除连接会退出网关；手机里的昵称、头像和外观选择会保留。
tip.en: Signing out clears the gateway connection while keeping local names, avatars and appearance choices.

zh: 核对完整远程 URL，确认没有额外追加 /api 或 /v1；点地址下方“在哪里找到地址？”可查看填写方法。
确认服务器和网关正在运行，手机能访问该地址，再核对用户名、密码。
已经保存过连接时，展开“诊断与 Agent 版本”，点击“诊断当前连接”，按失败项目处理后重试。
en: Check the complete Remote URL and remove any extra /api or /v1 suffix. Tap “Where do I find the address?” for help.
Confirm that the server and gateway are running, that your phone can reach them, and that the credentials are correct.
For a saved connection, expand “Diagnostics and Agent version” and tap “Diagnose current connection”. Resolve the reported failing step and retry.

tip.zh: 诊断页会列出本次运行中最近的失败环节和原因，不记录密码、对话正文或文件路径。普通只读请求中断会自动尝试一次，写入未确认时先核对结果再重试。
tip.en: Diagnostics list recent failure stages and categories from this run, without credentials, content or file paths. Interrupted reads retry once; verify unacknowledged writes before trying again.

title.zh: 首页人物会自己动，也可以点一下

zh: 在深度助理首页，右上角人物会自动轮流播放几个轻柔动作。
点击人物，她会眨眼回应，之后继续轮播。
如需保持安静，可在外观设置中开启“减少动态效果”。
en: The compact portrait on Personal assistant Home rotates through gentle movements.
Tap for a wink, then the carousel resumes.
Enable Reduce motion in appearance settings for a static portrait.

tip.zh: 动画在本机播放，不需要网络，不会创建 Agent 对话；离开首页或退到后台会停止。
tip.en: Animations play locally without a network or Agent session, and stop offscreen or in the background.

title.zh: 聊完事项后自动更新首页
title.en: Automatic Home updates after card conversations

zh: 在深度助理首页打开一张卡片，点击“聊聊这件事”或更新进展。
像平时聊天一样说明变化。Hermes 本轮结束后，App 会在后台核对这张卡片的相关进展。
返回首页即可查看更新；成功提示会自动收起。如需授权或更新未确认，点击“查看处理”继续。
en: Open a card on Personal assistant Home and discuss it or update its progress.
Explain changes naturally. After Hermes finishes the turn, the app checks progress for this card in the background.
Return Home to see the result. Successful notices disappear; use processing details if approval is needed or an update is unconfirmed.

tip.zh: 仅讨论或收到建议不会自动把事项标为完成。自动同步记录在“任务”中，不进入手机主动聊天列表。普通聊天仍可通过首页刷新合并最新进展。
tip.en: Discussion or advice alone does not complete a task. Automatic sync records stay in Tasks rather than the mobile conversation list. Use Home refresh to incorporate ordinary chats.

title.zh: 切换简洁首页与深度助理

zh: 首页右上角点击齿轮，在“首页模式”中选择“简洁首页”或“深度助理”，立即生效；重开 App 仍保留选择。
简洁首页保留人物、问候、“跟我说”和最近主动聊天。聊天、文件、任务和授权均可照常使用，无需配置首页整理。
深度助理显示事项与进展；选中后，再回到首页齿轮查看首次整理、早晚整理和文件收纳的说明。已有早晚配置无需重做。
en: Open the Home settings gear and choose Simple Home or Personal assistant. It applies immediately and survives app restarts.
Simple Home keeps the companion, greeting, Talk to me and recent user chats. Chat, files, tasks and approvals work without briefing setup.
Personal assistant shows your work and progress. Open the gear again for first-briefing, daily schedule and storage guidance. Existing schedules need no reconfiguration.

tip.zh: 切换只改变本机主页，不会删除资料、清理服务器对话或停止已有早晚任务；如需暂停，请到“任务”中操作。新用户默认简洁首页；检测到已有整理内容或任务记录的老用户升级后保留深度助理。
tip.en: Switching only changes Home on this device. It does not delete data, remove server conversations or stop existing schedules; pause them in Tasks. New users start with Simple Home; existing briefing users retain Personal assistant on upgrade.

zh: 点开卡片，先看背景、进展和来源；想继续讨论，选择“聊聊这件事”。
带有快捷回应的卡片可填写选择、日期或进度，再明确提交。App 核对服务器版本后开始处理，可在任务页查看。
卡片状态以服务器写回及核验结果为准。选择或提交不等于保存完成；冲突、网络失败或记录缺失会保留待核对状态。
需要更新既有整理规范时，到“首页 → 齿轮（首页设置） → 维护工具 → 更新整理规则”，正常使用不用重复操作。
en: Open a card to read its context, progress and sources. Choose Discuss to continue in a user conversation.
For cards with a quick response, enter your selection, date or progress, then submit explicitly. The app checks the server version and tracks processing in Tasks.
A selection or submission is not proof of completion. Card updates require verified server writes; conflicts and failures remain unconfirmed.
To update existing briefing rules, use Home → Settings gear → Maintenance tools → Update briefing rules. Routine use does not require this.

tip.zh: 无需数据库。真实写入由 Hermes 按规范处理；本版没有通用的 Agent 暂停/继续控制，也不会自动对外发送消息。
tip.en: No database is required. Hermes processes real writes under the contract. This version does not provide universal pause/resume controls or automatically send messages to others.

zh: 在首页右上角点击齿轮，进入“首页设置 → 早晚整理”。App 会核对已有配置并读取保存的时间与时区；按需修改。
点击“交给 Hermes 配置”，配置过程在任务页查看。设置一次后自动执行，想调整时间时再打开。
Hermes 先检查已有任务，避免重复；将规范保存到当前工作区，再创建或更新对应的早晚 Cron。
在“早晚整理”中核对实际任务是否生效。只有完成回读核验才表示配置成功；每次执行读取同一份已保存规范。
en: Open the Home settings gear → Daily schedule. The app checks saved settings and loads existing times and timezone; edit only when needed.
Tap Configure with Hermes and follow progress in Tasks. Set it once; return when you want to change the times.
Hermes checks existing jobs, persists the contract in the current workspace and configures the matching morning/evening jobs.
Verify the actual jobs in Daily schedule. Success requires read-back verification; each run loads the same saved contract.

tip.zh: 首页整理是可选功能，不配置也能使用聊天、文件和任务。日常刷新用首页刷新图标；只读同步在“首页设置 → 维护工具 → 同步与读取详情”。
tip.en: Home briefings are optional; chat, files and tasks work without setup. Use Home Refresh for new progress, or Home settings → Maintenance tools → Sync and read details for read-only sync.

title.zh: 让首页显示我的真实事项
title.en: Show my real work on Home

zh: 连接后，在首页齿轮中选择“深度助理”，再点击首页“开始整理”。
App 会带上工作区约定开始整理，处理过程在任务页查看；需要授权时会提示你确认。
深度助理首页前台约每分钟检查已保存内容，对话完成后也会同步。点击刷新图标，会让 Hermes 结合最近聊天核对进展并更新首页，页面显示处理状态；手机保留加密副本供断网时查看。
en: After connecting, choose Personal assistant in the Home settings gear, then tap Get started on Home.
The app starts a briefing task with the workspace contract. Follow it in Tasks; required approvals remain explicit.

Personal assistant Home checks saved content about once a minute and after completed turns. Tap the refresh icon to ask Hermes to reconcile recent chat progress and update the overview, with status shown on Home. Encrypted saved content remains visible offline.

tip.zh: 首页整理可选。不配置也可以正常聊天、读写文件和使用任务；新用户可从首页齿轮查看配置指引。
tip.en: Home briefings are optional. Chat, files and tasks work without setup; new users can open the Home settings gear for guidance.

title.en: Discuss a card or update progress

zh: 点击卡片先看问题、关键事实和选项；长背景及来源需要时再展开。
选择“聊聊这件事”或“补充进展”，背景会随草稿带入对话。
补充实际进展并发送，再点首页刷新图标，让 Hermes 核对最近对话并更新对应卡片。若显示“结果待核对”，点开处理详情；“继续未完成部分”会先核对已有结果，再处理缺少的部分。
en: Open a card for its question, key facts and options. Expand background or sources when needed.
Choose Discuss or Update. The card context is attached to a chat draft.

Send the actual progress, then tap the Home refresh icon to reconcile recent conversations and update the cards. Open an unconfirmed result for processing details; Continue unfinished work checks existing results before proceeding.

tip.zh: 打开卡片、生成方案不等于完成整个事项。
tip.en: Opening a card or generating a plan does not complete the underlying work.

zh: 首页右上角“齿轮 → 收纳首页文件”。这项操作只需一次。
Hermes 在任务页核对旧文件、匹配的概览 Cron 和正在进行的写入，再迁移到 .hermes-app/today，并同步规范、writer 命令和对应的 Cron 提示词。
成功后“首页设置”显示“首页文件已收纳，无需重复操作”。需要确认早晚任务时，进入“早晚整理”核对。
概览位置为 .hermes-app/today/hermes-today.json，锁为 .hermes-app/today/.hermes-today.lock，概览快照为 .hermes-app/today/snapshots/。业务文件不搬动。
en: Open Home → Settings gear → Organize overview files. This is a one-time operation.
Hermes checks legacy files, matching overview jobs and active writers in Tasks, then migrates files under .hermes-app/today and updates the contract, writer commands and matching Cron prompts.
Home settings shows that the overview files are organized after verification. Check daily jobs under Daily schedule.
The overview, lock and overview snapshots are stored under .hermes-app/today. Source documents stay in place.

tip.zh: 安装新版不会自动搬动服务器文件。冲突或仍在写入时会停止并说明原因；无需手工删除锁或移动其他程序的快照。
tip.en: Installing the update does not move server files automatically. Conflicts or active writers stop migration with an explanation; do not manually delete locks or move unrelated snapshots.

zh: 点击“帮我做…”，选择工作、学习、生活等类别。
选择具体场景，补充本次目标、要求或背景。
点击“带入对话”检查草稿，可在对话中添加附件后发送。
en: Tap Help me… and choose Work, Learning, Life or another category.
Choose a scene and add your goal, requirements or background.
Tap Continue in chat, review the draft, add any attachments and send.

tip.zh: 场景用于提供起点，不会根据你的职业给你固定身份。
tip.en: Scenes provide starting points; they do not assign you a fixed identity based on your job.

zh: 首页先展示四件重点事项；点击“查看其余”展开，或用分类切换范围。
首页先显示事项及完整的简短背景；决定卡打开详情后再选择。详情有固定操作区，顶部“关闭”返回首页。
资料统一从底部“文件”进入，继续浏览真实工作区目录。
“聊聊这件事”进入普通聊天；快捷回应需明确提交后才作为任务处理。卡片状态以服务器写回结果为准。
en: Home shows four focus items. Expand the remainder or filter by topic.
Home explains each item before asking for a response. Open decision details to choose; actions remain fixed and Close returns Home.
Open the Files tab to browse the real workspace directories.
Discuss opens a user conversation. A quick response starts a task only after explicit submission; card state follows verified server results.

tip.zh: 右上角“修正卡片与整理规则”会请求 Hermes 修正服务器内容；仅安装新版不会自行改动已有 JSON 或 Cron。
tip.en: Improve cards and briefing rules asks Hermes to update server content. Installing an app update alone does not rewrite JSON or Cron jobs.

hint.zh: 开始新对话、查找记录、添加资料
hint.en: Start chats, find history and add material

zh: 进入“回看”，长按要改名的对话。
点击“重命名”，修改输入框里的对话名。
点击“保存”，名称同步到当前 Profile 的服务器记录。
en: Open History and press and hold a conversation.
Choose Rename and edit its name.
Choose Save to update the conversation in its server profile.

tip.zh: 对话名最多 120 个字符。不会让 AI 重新取名，也不会修改聊天内容；日常对话改名后仍通过原会话继续。
tip.en: Names allow up to 120 characters. No AI naming or message changes are involved. A renamed daily conversation retains its original binding.

title.zh: 复制或朗读 AI 回答
title.en: Copy or read an AI answer aloud

zh: 等待 AI 回答完成，点击正文下方的“复制”或“朗读”。
复制保留完整正文与原有换行，不包含单独的思考过程。
朗读时点击“停止朗读”可停止；点另一条回答会切换朗读内容。返回列表、切换对话或开始录音时也会停止。
en: Wait for the answer to finish, then tap Copy or Read aloud below it.
Copy preserves the answer and line breaks, excluding the separate reasoning section.
Tap Stop reading to stop. Choosing another answer switches playback; leaving the chat, changing conversations or starting voice input also stops it.

tip.zh: 手动朗读无需麦克风权限。自动引擎优先使用手机发音人，失败后尝试 Hermes；所需语音包或服务器 TTS 需可用。
tip.en: Manual read-aloud does not need microphone permission. Automatic mode tries a matching phone voice, then Hermes. A supported phone voice or working server TTS is required.

zh: 在助理页点击“跟我说”，进入日常助理对话；也可以点“接着上次的事”里的记录继续聊。
想开启独立话题时，进入“回看”，点击右上角的新建按钮。
在输入框写下需求并发送；右上角“⋯ → 完整对话”可以查看前后文。
en: Tap “Talk to me” on the assistant home for your daily conversation, or choose a recent conversation to continue it.
For a separate topic, open History and tap the compose button at the top right.
Type and send your request. Use ⋯ → Full conversation to read the surrounding messages.

zh: 进入底部“回看”，点右上角放大镜，输入标题或记得的关键词。
需要缩小范围时，回到列表，使用项目和时间筛选。
点开结果后选择“完整对话”，向上滚动查看更早的消息。
en: Open History, tap the search icon at the top right and enter a title or remembered keyword.
Use the project and time filters on the list to narrow the results.
Open a result and choose Full conversation, then scroll up to earlier messages.

title.zh: 把文件或图片交给助理
title.en: Add a file or image to a chat

zh: 在对话输入框左侧点击“＋”。
选择“文件”或“图片”从手机添加资料；选择“空间”可以挑选服务器上的文件。
确认资料已经出现在输入区，再补充你希望如何处理它，最后发送。
en: Tap + to the left of the chat input.
Choose File or Image for material on your phone, or Workspace to pick a file on the server.
Wait for the attachment to appear in the input area, describe what you want done and send the message.

title.zh: 设置自己的提示词片段

zh: 在对话中点击“＋”，找到“提示词片段”，点击旁边的“管理”。
新增或编辑片段，填写名称和正文后保存；也可以调整顺序或删除不再使用的片段。
返回添加面板，点一个片段将内容放入输入框，检查并修改后再发送。
en: Tap + in a chat, find Prompt snippets and tap Manage.
Add or edit a snippet, enter its name and text and save. You can also reorder or remove snippets.
Return to the add panel and tap a snippet to insert it into the draft. Review or edit the text before sending.

hint.zh: 语音输入、连续语音、识别排查
hint.en: Dictation, continuous voice and recognition problems

title.zh: 使用英语或其他语言识别

zh: 打开“我的 → 设置 → 语音”。在页面前部找到“Hermes 识别语言”与“手机识别语言”。
说英语时，Hermes 选择 English 或自动检测；手机选择 English (US)、English (UK) 或跟随手机语言。
Hermes 语言在弹窗确认后保存。看到保存成功提示后再录音测试；失败时保留原设置。
“中文文字样式”仅用于简繁转换，不是语音语言选择，也不会把英文翻译成中文。
en: Open Me → Settings → Voice. Find Hermes recognition language and Phone recognition language near the top.
For English speech, select English or Detect automatically for Hermes. Select English (US), English (UK), or Follow phone language for the phone.
Confirm the Hermes language to save it. Wait for the saved notice before testing; a failed save keeps the previous setting.
Chinese text style only converts simplified/traditional characters. It does not choose a spoken language or translate English into Chinese.

tip.zh: 可识别语言取决于服务器模型或手机识别服务；已有语言选择会保留，不会因界面切换而自动覆盖。
tip.en: Supported languages depend on the server model or phone recognition service. Existing language choices are preserved when the interface language changes.

zh: 进入“我的 → 设置 → 语音设置”，确认“启用语音功能”已打开。
回到对话，点击输入框旁的语音按钮，首次使用时允许麦克风权限。
说完后结束录音，检查识别出来的内容，再按页面提示发送或继续对话。
en: Open Me → Settings → Voice settings and turn on Enable voice.
Return to a chat and tap the voice button beside the input. Grant microphone permission when first asked.
Finish recording, review the recognized text and use the available send or continue action.

title.zh: 开始连续语音并中途打断

zh: 在对话右上角点击“⋯ → 连续语音”。
允许录音后开始说话；助理回答时，按照页面上的打断按钮暂停它，再继续说。
返回对话即可退出连续语音。停留在前台连续语音页面时，屏幕会保持点亮。
en: Open ⋯ → Voice chat at the top right of a chat.
Allow recording and speak. While the assistant is answering, use the interrupt control to stop it and speak again.
Return to the chat to leave continuous voice. The screen stays awake while this voice page is in the foreground.

tip.zh: 切到后台或退出语音页后，恢复系统正常息屏；手动锁屏仍然有效。
tip.en: Normal screen timeout resumes in the background or after leaving the voice page. You can still lock the phone manually.

title.zh: 语音听不清或无法识别

zh: 先到手机系统设置确认 Hermes 的麦克风权限已允许，并检查网络连接。
进入“我的 → 设置 → 语音设置”，检查语音引擎和收音环境。
Agent 语音服务不可用时，可尝试自动或手机系统引擎，再用一句短话测试；中文转写形式可以在同页调整。
en: Check that Hermes has microphone permission in Android settings, then check your connection.
Open Me → Settings → Voice settings and review the voice engine and recording environment.
If Agent voice services are unavailable, try the automatic or device engine and test a short sentence. Chinese transcription style can be changed on the same page.

hint.zh: 工作目录、预览编辑、分享文件
hint.en: Workspace paths, previews, editing and sharing

zh: 进入“回看”，在顶部视图筛选中切换到“项目”，点击“新建项目”。
填写项目名称和服务器上的绝对工作目录，也可以点击“浏览目录”选择。
Windows 示例为 D:\Hermes\workspace；Linux 示例为 /home/user/workspace。确认后创建项目。
en: Open History, switch the top view filter to Projects and tap New project.
Enter a project name and an absolute directory on the server, or use Browse directories.
For Windows, use a path such as D:\Hermes\workspace; for Linux, use /home/user/workspace. Confirm to create the project.

tip.zh: 填写的是运行 Agent 的电脑目录，不是手机存储路径。
tip.en: This is a directory on the computer running the Agent, not on your phone.

zh: 进入底部“文件”，选择目录并点开目标文件。
Markdown 等可编辑文本可以切换到编辑界面；修改正文后点击保存。
返回列表前确认保存成功；不支持编辑的文件使用预览或下载功能。
en: Open Files, browse to the directory and open the file.
For editable text such as Markdown, switch to the editor, make your changes and save.
Confirm that saving succeeded before leaving. Use preview or download for other file types.

title.en: Share a file created by the assistant

zh: 点击回答中的文件卡片，或到“文件”中找到对应文件。
打开预览后点击分享按钮，选择目标应用。
如果目标应用不能接收该类型文件，先下载文件，再从手机的文件管理器分享。
en: Tap the file card in a reply, or find the file in Files.
Open the preview, tap Share and choose an app.
If the app cannot accept that file type, download it first and share it from your phone’s file manager.

hint.zh: 定时执行、查看结果、处理确认

zh: 进入底部“任务”，点击新建按钮，填写任务名称。
在“让 Hermes 做什么”中写清任务要求，再设置 Cron 表达式；每天 9 点可填写 0 9 * * *。
点击创建，打开任务详情检查时间和内容；查看首次执行结果，再按需要调整。
en: Open Tasks, tap New task and enter a name.
Describe the work in “What should Hermes do?” and set a Cron expression. For 9:00 every day, enter 0 9 * * *.
Create the task, then check its schedule and prompt in the details. Review the first result and adjust as needed.

tip.zh: 执行时间取决于服务器任务调度所用时区，请核对任务详情。
tip.en: Execution time follows the server scheduler’s time zone. Check the task details.

title.zh: 查看结果或暂停定时任务
title.en: Review results or pause a scheduled task

zh: 打开“任务 → 当前”查看处理进展和待确认事项。
“记录”收纳自动刷新、整理、配置、卡片处理和定时执行记录。点开查看详情、结果或补充要求。
主动发起的聊天保留在会话列表。自动任务不会在会话列表、对话搜索或分享目标中出现，也不会自动删除。
在“定时”中打开安排，可调整或暂停后续执行。
en: Open Tasks → Current for progress and pending requests.
History includes automated refreshes, briefings, setup, card processing and scheduled runs. Open an item for details.
User conversations stay in the conversation list. Automated tasks are excluded from conversation browsing, search and share targets, and are not automatically deleted.
Open Scheduled to adjust or pause a schedule.

tip.zh: 自动整理和卡片处理记录归入手机“任务”，不挤占聊天列表。这里只做手机端分类，服务器记录仍保留，所以 PC 端仍可能看到；不会自动删除真实对话。
tip.en: Automatic briefings and card processing appear in mobile Tasks. This is a mobile-only classification: server records remain and may still appear on PC. Conversations are not automatically deleted.

title.zh: 处理需要你确认的操作

zh: 首页或任务页出现“等你决定”时，点“查看并确认”。授权窗口位置固定，完整命令、说明和选项可上下滚动。
选择允许范围或拒绝，再点“确认并继续”。没有选择前不会提交授权。
如果已经在电脑处理，可点“已在其他端处理？核对状态”。窗口内直接显示进度和结果；服务器确认结束后提醒自动消失。
关闭窗口只是暂时收起；尚未处理的请求仍可从首页或任务页打开。
旧服务器无法核对时，若你已确认在其他端处理，可点击“已处理，移除此提醒”，再明确确认移除。只移除手机提醒，不会授权、拒绝或重跑服务器操作。
en: Tap Review and confirm on Home or Tasks. Read the full command, explanation and choices in the fixed, scrollable window.
Choose an available approval scope or denial, then confirm. Nothing is approved before your explicit choice.
If handled on your computer, tap Check status. Progress and results appear inside the window; confirmed resolved requests disappear.
Closing the window only defers it; pending requests remain available on Home and Tasks.

If an older server cannot verify the state and you have confirmed it was handled elsewhere, choose Remove reminder and confirm. This only removes the local reminder; it does not approve, deny or rerun server work.

tip.zh: 网络不通或旧网关未提供明确状态时会保留请求；不会把核对状态当作同意授权。
tip.en: Requests are preserved when offline or when an older gateway provides no authoritative status. Checking status never approves an operation.

hint.zh: 昵称头像、主题语言、长期记忆
hint.en: Names, avatars, appearance, language and memory

title.zh: 更换助理昵称和双方头像

zh: 进入“我的 → 编辑信息”。
在“你的助理”中更换头像、修改昵称；在“你的信息”中修改自己的头像、称呼或签名。
点击保存。助理页会显示“我是 + 助理昵称”，其他页面也使用更新后的资料。
en: Open Me → Edit profile.
Under Your assistant, change the avatar or name. Under Your profile, change your own avatar, name or bio.
Save your changes. The home header displays “I’m” followed by the assistant name, and other pages use the updated profile.

zh: 进入“我的 → 设置 → 外观”，选择温暖、玻璃或安静风格。
在同一面板选择浅色、深色或跟随系统；如果希望减少动态效果，可开启减少动画。
返回设置，进入“语言”选择简体中文、English 或跟随系统。
en: Open Me → Settings → Appearance and choose the warm, glass or quiet skin.
Choose light, dark or system colors in the same panel. Enable reduced motion if you prefer fewer animations.
Return to Settings and open Language to choose Simplified Chinese, English or the system language.

tip.zh: 语言切换只影响软件界面，不会自动翻译已有对话和服务器文件。
tip.en: The language setting changes the app interface. It does not translate existing chats or server files.

zh: 进入“我的 → 设置 → 外观”，下滑到“桌面图标”。
选择“白发伙伴”或“耳机精灵”，出现成功提示后返回手机桌面。
桌面可能需要几秒刷新。切换只改变软件图标，不会修改对话里的头像。
en: Open Me → Settings → Appearance, then scroll to App icon.
Choose Partner or Sprite. After the confirmation, return to your home screen.
Your launcher may take a few seconds to refresh. This only changes the app icon, not conversation avatars.

tip.zh: 图标选择会保留，下次打开和升级后无需重新设置。
tip.en: Your selection is kept across app restarts and upgrades.

title.zh: 点击人物播放互动动作

zh: 在助理首页点一下白发女孩，播放一个互动动作。
动作结束后再点，会播放另一款；播放中连续点击不会重新开始。
如需静态人物，进入“我的 → 设置 → 外观”开启“减少动态效果”。
en: Tap the white-haired assistant on Home to play a gesture.
After it finishes, tap again for the other gesture. Repeated taps during playback do not restart it.
For a still character, enable Reduce Motion in Me → Settings → Appearance.

tip.zh: 离开首页或切到后台会结束本次互动；Android 8 设备使用静态人物。
tip.en: Leaving Home or backgrounding ends the gesture. Android 8 devices use still artwork.

zh: 在“我的”页面打开“我的记忆”，先阅读当前内容。
进入编辑，补充或修改需要长期保留的偏好与事实。
保存后再次打开核对；若要调整人格与行为方式，使用“我的心智”。
en: Open My memory on the Me page and read the current content.
Enter the editor and add or revise the facts and preferences you want to retain.
Save, reopen and review your changes. To adjust personality and behavior, use My mind instead.

tip.zh: 这些内容属于当前 Agent Profile，与手机上的头像和昵称设置分开。
tip.en: These files belong to the current Agent Profile and are separate from local names and avatars.
